subject: Important Update: Your Flight Details
body: Dear [Name], We wanted to inform you about some changes to your upcoming flight. Due to unforeseen circumstances, the departure time has been shifted by 2 hours. Please review the updated details in your itinerary and make any necessary adjustments to your schedule. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer support team for assistance. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
